description: HAL I2C1 bus scan (PB6 SCL / PB7 SDA, 100 kHz): HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady on 0x08-0x77, 'found 0xNN' per device, 'scan done N' on USART1
expect:
72 MHz. I2C1 on PB6 (SCL) / PB7 (SDA), AF open-drain, 100 kHz standard mode (PCLK1 36 MHz: FREQ 36, CCR 180 = 5 us high / 5 us low, TRISE 37); the bus needs pull-ups. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Once after reset: 'I2C1 scan 0x08-0x77
', then HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady (1 trial, 2 ms) on every address 0x08..0x77 in order: 'found 0xNN
' for each acknowledging device (an AT24C02 with A2-A0 at GND: 'found 0x50'); a NACKed probe (START, address, NACK, STOP) takes about 115 us on the bus. Then 'scan done N
' (N = devices found), and the core sleeps (WFI) with SCL/SDA released high. Without pull-ups SDA/SCL never read high: SR2.BUSY stays set, the first probe returns HAL_BUSY after 25 ms and the scan stops: 'bus busy at 0x08: SDA/SCL stuck low (pull-ups?)
scan done 0
'. A START that is never generated (HAL_TIMEOUT) prints 'timeout at 0xNN' and stops.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
